name: Croft Reserve Tawny
serverNotes:
🇵🇹 📖 ABOUT: Tawny port from Croft - one of oldest port houses! Founded 1588. 40 proof. From Douro Valley's steep terraced vineyards.

🍷 PROFILE: Sweet & Smooth | Caramel, toasted nuts, dried fruit & vanilla | Wood-aged for mellow oxidative character | Beautiful amber color | Approachable entry to port!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Roasted almonds, aged Manchego, chocolate torta, crème brûlée.

💡 SERVING: Perfect dessert wine or digestif! Serve slightly chilled (60°F). Excellent value!
location: Croft Port lodges, Vila Nova de Gaia

name: Dow's 10 Year
serverNotes:
🍷 📖 ABOUT: Premium 10-year tawny from legendary Dow's. Est. 1798. 40 proof. Age statement verified! Historic Symington family. What proper tawny should taste like!

🍷 PROFILE: Smooth & Complex | Caramel, dried apricot, toasted hazelnuts, fig & milk chocolate | 10 years in seasoned oak | Mellow oxidative character | Remarkable depth!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Stilton blue cheese, roasted pecans, caramel flan, apple tart.

💡 SERVING: Serve slightly chilled (60-65°F) to enhance nutty notes. Excellent value aged port!
location: Dow's (Symington) lodges, Vila Nova de Gaia

name: Dow's Late Bottled Vintage 2003
serverNotes:
🍷 📖 ABOUT: Late Bottled Vintage port from exceptional 2003 harvest by Dow's. 40 proof. LBV aged 4-6 years! Ready to drink now - no decanting needed!

🍷 PROFILE: Full & Intense | Dark blackberry, bitter chocolate, warm spice & black pepper | Vintage-style character | Great alternative to expensive vintage at fraction of price!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Roquefort blue cheese, chocolate lava cake, roasted chestnuts, dark chocolate truffles.

💡 SERVING: Cool room temp (60-65°F). Excellent value from Quinta do Bomfim estate!
location: Dow's (Symington) lodges, Vila Nova de Gaia

name: Fonseca 20 Year
serverNotes:
✨ 📖 ABOUT: Exceptional 20-year tawny from prestigious Fonseca. Founded 1815. 40 proof. Port house artistry at its peak!

🍷 PROFILE: Smooth & Luxurious | Burnt caramel, dried figs, toasted walnuts, warm spice & butterscotch | 20 years in wood creates incredible depth | Amber-brick color | Sweet spot of aged tawny!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Foie gras terrine, Stilton blue cheese, crème brûlée, almond biscotti.

💡 SERVING: For special occasions! Lightly chilled (55-60°F). Profoundly refined!
location: Fonseca lodges, Vila Nova de Gaia

name: Quinta do Noval 2018 Vintage
serverNotes:
🍷 📖 ABOUT: Premium vintage port from legendary Quinta do Noval's exceptional 2018 harvest! 40 proof. Since 1715. Universally declared vintage. Portuguese port royalty!

🍷 PROFILE: Powerful & Age-Worthy | Concentrated dark cherry, bitter chocolate, exotic spice, black pepper & fig | Made only in declared vintage years (2-3 per decade) | Cellar until 2040+! Liquid history!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Roquefort blue cheese, 85% dark chocolate, roasted walnuts, Stilton.

💡 SERVING: For special occasions & collectors! Decant first. Investment-grade port!
